name: Mark of the Forge
description: 20% when a weapon art's HP cost is paid: the cost is not taken.

name: Mark of the Hunt
description: 15% per strike: +5 damage on that strike.

name: Mark of the Veil
description: 15% when a magic strike lands on the bearer: halves its damage.

name: Mark of the Road
description: 25% at the start of your phase: +1 MOV this turn.
